mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, labor market tightness drives wage inflation, ultimately leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased production costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
